name: Academy Town
notes: Coordinates in metres: x east, z south (toward the default camera), y up; settled ground at y = 0 and it never changes.
Field names follow docs/design/world/layouts/layout.schema.json (version 2), which mirrors prototypes/biome-lab/src/layout/biome-layout.ts where the concept matches.
population is keyed by band percentage; it maps 1:1 onto the lab's PopulationTable [0, 25, 50, 75, 100].

Structure borrowed from the MIT campus references (court to river, one long corridor, a square with a transit entrance, a chapel, one sculptural building, a dorm street along the river); every form is an original toybox low-poly design. No real names or logos exist in the world.
Frame: 200 x 200 m, x and z in [-100, 100]. The back (z < -80) is the hall skyline that dissolves into fog; the front (z > bank) is the river.

Normalised to version 2 on 2026-09-20. Three geometric edits were needed to satisfy the 15 m landmark clearance rule with the plinth kept at (0, -28) r 12: Great Court north edge moved from z = -14 to z = -1 (the 13 m of axis between them is now an open approach to the plinth steps, outside the district); Long Corridor centreline moved from z = -57 to z = -67 (width 24 unchanged); skyline foot moved from z = -76 to z = -80 (range.footDepth 10 -> 6). Revert those three numbers to restore the v1 drawing exactly.

outline.description: one landmass filling the frame north of the river bank; the back third (z < -80) rises into the hall skyline and dissolves in fog; no back coastline is ever visible

skyline.description: a continuous row of flat-roofed limestone lecture halls at the skyline foot, with a bell tower, tower blocks and small pale domes growing behind them by course fraction; the back row sits in fog

coastCliff.description: Brick river embankment wall with a limestone coping course; the only cliff in the biome. The far bank does not exist: open basin fading into the front fog beyond z = 92.

river.farBank: none; open basin fading into front fog beyond z = 92

riverWalk.note: Also listed as transit line river-walk.

water.description: The river, 48 m from the brick bank to the front fog; the camera arrives over it from the south.

soloIsland.feature: river observatory: 12-facet brick drum r 5 m, h 6 m, white faceted dome to 10 m, one slit; boathouse shed 8 x 5 x 4 m; 10 m dock north-west toward the bank with 3 moored sailboats; flagpole with pennant
soloIsland.access: sailboat route from the Dorm Row dock; no bridge

transit.description: River road along the whole bank; straight segments, jitter <= 0.05; a tree row of 6 pollarded sycamores between road and dorms in Dorm Row.
River walk 2 m inland of the bank with lamps every 8 m (derived from land.extras.riverWalk.offsetFromBank).
The 4 m paving axis from the river road up the Great Court to the landmark plinth steps at z = -16.
The 15 m paving link from the Long Corridor lane south to the landmark court's north steps.

districts.name: Dorm Row
districts.fittedTo: the river bank and river road on the west half of the shore

anchor.description: boathouse dock spur into the river + the river-walk lamp line + the chapel spire
anchor.silhouette48: a comb tooth sticking into the water with a dotted line along the bank

features: 2 wave dorms 18 x 7 x 9 m, brick, flat roof with a pergola, plan bends once
2 grid dorms 12 x 7 x 9 m, brick, dense square-window grid, one big cut-out
2 block dorms 8 x 7 x 9 m, brick
chapel: 12-facet brick drum r 4 m, h 7 m, on a 0.6 m moat ring, 3-rod verdigris spire to 14 m with one bell
boathouse 10 x 6 x 5 m, limestone with brick base, marigold doors, 14 m dock into the river, 3 sailboats moored
river road (5 m) with a tree row of 6 pollarded sycamores between road and dorms
river walk with lamps every 8 m, 4 bench pairs, 3 bike racks

populationNotes.0: dock + lamp line + chapel moat ring (empty)
populationNotes.25: boathouse + 1 wave dorm; marigold doors and first sail
populationNotes.50: + 1 grid dorm + 1 block dorm; tree row; benches
populationNotes.75: + chapel + 1 wave dorm; bike racks, lit windows, 3 sailboats
populationNotes.100: + 1 grid dorm + 1 block dorm; roof pergolas, rowing shell, second dock finger

accent.object: boathouse doors and the first sailboat sail

districts.name: Great Court
districts.fittedTo: the flat lawn between the river road and the open approach to the landmark plinth, framed by two hall arms

anchor.description: the pale axis stripe up the middle of a green rectangle, tree rows both sides, plinth steps at its head
anchor.silhouette48: green rectangle with a pale stripe and two dotted tree lines

features: west arm: 3 lecture halls 12 x 14 x 9 m, limestone, colonnade of 6 columns facing the lawn, flat roof
east arm: 3 lecture halls, same kit, mirrored
lawn 28 x 41 m with a 4 m paving axis from the river road to the plinth steps (the last 13 m of axis run through open lawn outside the district)
2 tree rows of 8 pollarded trees (round canopies 4 m)
8 bench pairs facing the axis, 2 lamp rows
6 geese grazing (ambient), students crossing the lawn diagonally

populationNotes.25: first hall each arm; marigold banner between the columns
populationNotes.50: + 1 hall each arm; tree rows; benches
populationNotes.75: all 6 halls; lamps; lit windows; geese
populationNotes.100: column-top pennants, 4 statues on plinths, a second axis of lamps, chalk drawings on the paving

accent.object: banner hung between the first hall's columns

districts.name: Long Corridor
districts.fittedTo: the flat band just in front of the skyline foot (z = -80 at centre), running east-west across the back of the land

anchor.description: the straight 100 m lane with its column comb and poster boards
anchor.silhouette48: a long pale line with a row of dots along one side

features: one 4 m paving lane, 100 m end to end, walkable without a break
open arcade on the south side: 25 limestone columns every 4 m carrying a flat 3 m canopy
12 attached halls 10 x 12 x 8 m: 6 on the north side (limestone) and 6 on the south side beyond the arcade (brick and limestone alternating)
8 poster boards 2.4 x 2 m on the arcade piers: cream boards with marigold and coral rectangles
4 clock posts, 12 lamps, 2 bike-rack banks
15 m paving link south from the lane to the landmark court's north steps
streams of students walking the lane in both directions (ambient)

populationNotes.25: 3 halls; first poster board and a coral banner across the lane
populationNotes.75: 10 halls; all boards; lamps lit; student stream
populationNotes.100: 12 halls; pennants on the arcade; a food cart; second lamp row

accent.object: first poster board's marigold poster and the coral banner across the lane

districts.name: Station Square
districts.fittedTo: the east shoulder of the land between the corridor's east end and the river road

anchor.description: the transit canopy + fountain dot + the ring of stall canopies on the paved square
anchor.silhouette48: a pale square with a dot in it and a small comb of canopies

features: transit portal 6 x 4 x 4.5 m: steel frame, glass sides, marigold sign band (no text), stair down, 4 bollards, 2 planters
paved square 30 x 26 m with a 12-facet fountain basin r 3 m
cafe 8 x 8 x 6 m, brick, marigold awning, 8 marigold chairs and 4 tables outside
museum 14 x 10 x 8 m, brick with one glass gable end
3 townhouses 6 x 8 x 5.5 m, brick, flat roofs, shop fronts
market: 8 stall canopies 3 x 3 m (marigold, coral, cream rotation)
studio: three leaning brick-and-limestone blocks 8 x 8 x 12 m with tilted flat roofs, the one sculptural building
4 lamps, a clock post, 2 bike-rack banks, a newspaper kiosk

populationNotes.25: portal glazed + cafe; marigold sign band and awning; 2 stalls
populationNotes.100: + studio; 8 stalls; kiosk; pennant on the studio

accent.object: transit portal sign band and the cafe awning

districts.name: Observatory Island
districts.fittedTo: the river island 21 m off the east bank

anchor.silhouette48: a green blob in the water with a white dot and a stick

features: river observatory: 12-facet brick drum r 5 m, h 6 m, white faceted dome to 10 m with a slit, verdigris cap
boathouse shed 8 x 5 x 4 m, limestone, marigold doors
10 m dock toward the bank with 3 sailboats moored, a sail rack
flagpole 8 m with a marigold pennant, 2 round trees, a bench

populationNotes.75: + dome; sailboats; lit slit at night
populationNotes.100: telescope tracks at night, second dock finger, sail rack full

landmark.name: Dome Hall

plinth.steps: south, 4 steps 0.15 m onto the Great Court axis; north, 15 m link to the Long Corridor lane
plinth.description: At the head of the Great Court: 15 m of open lawn and axis paving to the court's north edge (z = -1), 15 m of link paving to the Long Corridor (z = -55).

s1.name: Lectern
s1.description: limestone plinth with a lectern and a bell on a post (4 m), two benches, marigold pennant on the post
lights: one lamp on the bell post

s2.name: Reading Hall
s2.description: colonnaded limestone hall, 4 fat columns, low pediment; the bell post becomes a roof cupola

s3.name: Dome Hall
s3.description: the hall widens to 6 columns and gains a squat 12-facet drum with a low faceted dome, verdigris lantern cap and marigold pennant; oculus glows at night; bell rings on the hour

landmark.ipNote: six columns not ten, squat faceted drum, low dome with lantern and pennant, no inscription band, brick river wall below; this is not a copy of the reference dome

marker.rim: stone coping course over brick, 12 engaged buttresses one per facet

props.description: skyline bell tower: brick shaft, limestone cupola, verdigris cap, marigold pennant
dome hall (landmark s3): limestone, 6 columns, squat faceted dome, verdigris lantern
wave dorm block: brick, one bend, 6 windows, flat roof
transit portal: steel frame, glass sides, marigold band, with one round court tree beside it

marker.silhouette48: a brick disc with a green top; one thin tower with a white cap and a low pale dome beside it
marker.night: dorm windows, portal glass, dome oculus and cupola lamp emissive #ffe9a8 x 1.6; pedestal never emits

bells.landmark: 3-note peal on the hour from s2

night.order: dorms first, then corridor, then square, then court

catastrophe.weather: paper storm: torn posters and exam sheets swirl in from the skyline, sky to #c9c4bd
catastrophe.fallApart: students flop onto the lawn, backpacks spill, sailboats turtle, geese scatter
catastrophe.ruin: exam-week blackout: every window dark except one flickering lamp per district, poster boards bare, market stalls collapsed, pennants drooping, papers carpeting the lawn
catastrophe.recovery: lights return dorm by dorm, papers sweep into bins, stalls re-pitch, pennants re-hoist, the bell rings
